Test a robust DBA combination on the full pool to see if it improves over weighted inverse_error, given trend-dominated regime and unstable ranking.
test a per-horizon weighted scheme that may capture subtle horizon differences in a trend-dominated, weakly seasonal series.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable rankings; a robust median over a small, diverse pool (pool4) may reduce variance.
Try a trimmed mean over the full pool to reduce influence of the very poor models while keeping more diversity, given the trend‑dominated series and unstable ranking.
try a per‑horizon weighted combination using the top‑k mean handle (w5) to capture potential horizon‑specific winners, addressing the unstable ranking hint.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable ranking; a forward‑selection style weight may capture complementary errors across models.
Ranking is unstable and several models are correlated; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting may capture complementary strengths across horizons in a trend‑dominated series.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking, so a robust weighted combo may help; test a different weight handle (w4) on the full pool to see if another weighting improves over median pool4.
The series is trend dominated with unstable ranking; a robust median over all models may improve stability.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.8908. Series context: trend strength 0.9587 and seasonal strength 0.2783; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.014); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.237.
